name: Yamato
configuration: 7 April 1945 exterior fit; 10.4 m trial waterline datum; reconstruction under dimensional review

accuracy.exterior: 263 m LOA / 38.9 m beam. Original reconstruction; station offsets, hull sections and fittings remain under review. See references/sources.json and reports/discrepancies.md.
accuracy.internals: Provisional gameplay compartments, armor proxies and calibrated buoyancy; not historical internal subdivisions.
accuracy.weapons: 46 cm triple geometry uses USNTMJ O-45(N) measured spacing, roller path and trunnion dimensions. Secondary shapes and exterior station measurements remain interpreted; combat is approximate.

propulsion.basis: Two retained combined-drive envelopes stand in for the boiler/turbine/shaft plant, with equal provisional power shares. This is not a recovered steam-routing plan.
